lines.en: My footsteps are the bell.
Shield forward. I do not stop.
This road answers to me.
Iron boots grind the gravel loudly.
I walk straight. I never detour.
Those behind me, keep pace.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了半条街。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the street.

lines.zh: 每一步都在丈量你的罪。
lines.en: Every step measures your guilt.

lines.zh: 盾边的铆钉走起来叮当。
lines.en: The shield rivets clink as I walk.
Wind in my face. I do not bow.
I do not hurry. I do not need to.
The road ahead is already cleared.
I stand the shield at my feet.

lines.zh: 我在等一个判决的理由。
lines.en: I wait for grounds for a verdict.
I tighten each finger of my gloves.
This shield has stopped a hundred blows.
I raise my hand and study the palm.
One rivet has come loose.
Dust in the wind. I do not blink.
Silence is also an interrogation.
I fasten the scabbard.
Time stands on my side.
Look up. Let me see your guilt.
Your eyes flinched away.
That face goes into the case file.
You weigh me. I weigh you.
You do not stand straight enough.
Your hand is searching for a weapon.
I read the shadow before the man.
You have the look of the accused.
Do not look away. It is impolite.
I lower my eyes and study you.
This force is not enough.
While the shield stands, so do I.
I take one step. No more.
To break the shield, break me first.
My armor is ringing.
Plenty of force. Little effect.
I do not shout, and I do not yield.
It hurts. I still stand straight.
This goes on the stone tablet.
You have my full attention now.
A bribe? Put it away.
Bread buys no mercy.
Emeralds? I have enough.
That iron in your hand is too light.
Do not hand me things. Speak first.
I accept it. The verdict stands.
I do not bend for food.
This is not enough to redeem you.
Your gift is entered into the record.
Take it away. It blocks my view.
Bumping me is bumping a wall.
You did not step back. Good.
My shield did not shift an inch.
Make way, or be pushed aside.
You crashed into me. Is your shoulder well?
I put a hand out and right you.
That bump counts as an offense.

lines.zh: 我的铁靴踩住了你的影。
lines.en: My boot pins your shadow.
Do not squeeze in from the side.
Steady yourself. I have not pushed yet.
You hold the left. I hold the right.
I will not leave you behind.

lines.zh: 我们一起受审，一起无罪。
lines.en: We stand trial together, acquitted together.
I will mend your shield.
I walk in front. That is the rule.
I heard your oath.
If you tire, lean on my shield.
Between us, no ceremony is needed.
I trust you once. That is enough.
Come back alive. That is an order.
I pick it up and check for an owner.
This platinum shard goes to the order.
Iron ingots are heavy. Good for the scales.
This leather is still serviceable.
I drop it into the pouch.
Lost property stays with me for now.
I crouch. The shield stays upright.
The emerald is marked as evidence.
This shard has a sharp edge.
I take two. The rest is yours.
Halt there. Give me your name.
I find you guilty.
I have listed three charges.
The shield is raised. The trial begins.
Flee, and the verdict still stands.
I never chase. I only conclude.
Your name is on the stone tablet.
This is your last chance. Kneel.
I raise the shield and take one step.
The verdict does not require your consent.
You have crossed the boundary.
Now the reckoning begins.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看一份状纸。
lines.en: I regard you as I would a writ.

lines.zh: 这一场，只有一个人出去。
lines.en: Only one walks out of this.
What you carry must be recorded.
Stand on this side of the slab.

lines.zh: 我举盾的方向就是判词。
lines.en: My shield's face is the verdict.
First I break your stance.
The shield will not yield. Neither will I.
Strike the shield and your grip goes numb.

lines.zh: 呼吸太急，我听得一清二楚。
lines.en: Your breaths come fast. I hear them clearly.
Your opening is the right shoulder.
This shield still holds.

lines.zh: 我侧盾，把你的力道卸掉。
lines.en: I angle the shield and shed your force.
Inch by inch, I press forward.
Do not rush. I have great patience.
Your weapon will dull first.
I fix my eyes on your wrist.
I keep count of the dents.

lines.zh: 你每一次后退，我都记得。
lines.en: I remember every step you yield.
The sentence is short. The deed is long.
Your shield slipped an inch.
I count to seven. You have not moved.

lines.zh: 石板上的名字快念完了。
lines.en: The slab's names are nearly read out.
Your allies are backing off. Noted.
This one step is mine.
I lower my point three fingers.
The shield edge comes down.
This blow will stay with you.
I drive my pommel into your jaw.
You will not stop the second.
My gauntlet lands on your shoulder.
I shove with the shield and clear you aside.
This blade falls true.
You kneel. The verdict takes effect.

lines.zh: 我不补第二剑，除非必要。
lines.en: I do not strike twice unless needed.
Shield first. Sword after.
Your armor has a dent now.
I raise my hand. You step back.
That counts as a warning.
You can still stand. Not bad.
My edge knocks your bracer aside.
My knee meets your belly plate.
I set foot on this land.
The shield rests before my feet.
This place needs a verdict.
My arrival is the notice.
The dust settles behind me.
I lower my helm an inch.
Who makes noise here?
I come under orders.
This shield has never touched the ground.
The wind stops. Then I speak.
My step makes the ground sink.
The tribunal begins here.
Fire flows around the shield.
I use the shield to rise.
The water tries to drown me. The shield sinks first.
The shield takes most of the blast.
An arrow quivers in the shield.

lines.zh: 魔法绕着我转，找不到缝。
lines.en: Magic circles me, finding no gap.
Hunger does not change the verdict.
Lightning falls. I keep my feet.
The void is a kind of cell.
